base_member_text: [L36-L38] (MED/path/contract) The script changes to absolute `/config/` and then references `./teamcity-env.sh`, making the final module-generation step depend on an external directory rather than the checked-out config directory.
audit_member_text: [L36-L38] (MED/working-directory) Absolute /config/ is selected instead of the checkout's config directory before accessing teamcity-env.sh.

base_member_text: [L40] (LOW/permissions) The generated module file is made mode 777, granting unnecessary write/execute permissions to all users.
audit_member_text: [L40] (HIGH/shared-file-permissions) chmod 777 makes the installed environment module writable by all users.

base_member_text: [L21-L30] (MED/error-handling/reproducibility) The installation pipeline has no failure checks or `set -e`, so failed cleanup, autotools generation, configure, compilation, or installation can be followed by later publication steps.

audit_member_text: [L1-L39] (HIGH/shell-line-endings) CRLF line endings invalidate the Unix shebang and introduce literal carriage returns into Bash commands and variable values.
[L14-L38] (HIGH/build-failure-propagation) Failed dependency loading, configuration, compilation or installation does not prevent subsequent module publication.
[L27] (MED/scientific-compiler-semantics) Unconditional -ffast-math allows finite-value assumptions and numerical transformations that can compromise NaN diagnostics and change scientific results.
[L38] (MED/environment-path-mismatch) The reused teamcity-env.sh selects gcc_12.2.0_openmpi_4.1.5_HEAD rather than the gcc_7.3.0_openmpi_4.0.4_HEAD installation created here.
